title: Nagaland
subtitle: Hornbill Festival at Kisama, two days on the Dzükou trail, and walks through Kohima, Dzüleke and Khonoma.
location: Dimapur · Kisama · Dzükou · Kohima · Dzüleke · Khonoma

chapters.title: First afternoon in Dimapur
paragraphs: An airport welcome leads into painted walls, busy streets and old brickwork. The afternoon ends with rice and small bowls of accompaniments.
